view.scene_description: A modern indoor space with large windows overlooking a multi-story building. The room contains tables, chairs, and a prominent red curved structure. A cylindrical pillar stands near shelves holding books or boxes. Natural light illuminates the area, highlighting polished floors and minimalist furniture.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Tall, floor-to-ceiling glass panes dominate the right side of the frame, offering a view of an adjacent white building with many windows. They allow ample natural light into the room and show reflections of trees and sky.

objects.label: cylindrical pillar
objects.observation: A thick, dark gray pillar stands on the left side of the room, partially obscuring a doorway behind it. It has a smooth surface and appears to be structural, supporting the ceiling above.

objects.label: red curved structure
objects.observation: A bright red, curved architectural element is visible on the far left edge of the image. Its exact function is unclear, but it contrasts sharply with the neutral tones of the rest of the room.

objects.label: tables and chairs
objects.observation: Several round tables with transparent acrylic legs are arranged throughout the room, accompanied by blue-cushioned stools. Some chairs are stacked or placed under tables, suggesting a café or lounge setting.

objects.label: shelves with items
objects.observation: On the left side, near the pillar, there are tall, narrow shelves holding stacks of white boxes or books. These appear freestanding and are positioned against the wall.

objects.label: building outside windows
objects.observation: A multi-story white building with numerous rectangular windows is visible through the large windows. Trees are also visible between the windows, indicating an outdoor courtyard or plaza.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000050", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
